facts.text: Sam expressed willingness to try exercising with a goal and a partner.

evidence.quote: Yeah, that sounds like a good idea. Having goals and someone to exercise with might help. I'll give it a try!

facts.text: Evan encouraged Sam to focus on feeling good and reaching goals, and suggested planning a hike.

evidence.quote: Awesome, Sam! Getting started will get easier with time. And don't forget it's about feeling good and reaching goals, too. Let's plan a hike soon!

facts.text: Evan mentioned that he had been to the gym the day before and was gaining strength.

evidence.quote: It's great to see progress, was just at the gym yesterday. Gaining strength!

facts.text: Sam expressed excitement about getting fit with Evan and planned to go on a hike soon.

evidence.quote: Super excited to get fit with ya. Let's hit the trails soon!
